name: Whispering Coast
summary: Nine little escapes. One beautiful coast.

holes.name: Meadow Start
holes.summary: Find your rhythm on a sunlit meadow, with a generous green and room to learn.

holes.name: Orchard Bend
holes.summary: Choose your club and follow a gentle bend through the fruit trees.

holes.name: Ocean Point
holes.summary: Read the sea breeze and favor the welcoming inland fairway.

holes.name: Walled Garden
holes.summary: A short approach between warm sand bunkers and flowering garden beds.

holes.name: Clover Valley
holes.summary: Plan a patient route through the rolling clover valley.

holes.name: Heron Crossing
holes.summary: Carry the river or take the longer, gentler route by the bridge.

holes.name: Bellflower Rise
holes.summary: Climb toward a hilltop green, then take a moment to read its slope.

holes.name: Pine Passage
holes.summary: Find the clearings and place your shots between the coastal pines.

holes.name: Lighthouse Home
holes.summary: Bring it home along the headland, with the lighthouse watching over the green.
